title: ExpeL retry: loss -> reflection -> retry win -> recipe
shows: First attempt on "put a cloth in drawer" lost (30 steps). The agent reflects ("I never found the cloth..."), replays the same game with that reflection and wins in 10 steps. The Builder contrasts both attempts and writes a Success Process.
why_interesting: The complete retry sequence in one example. Note the cost: the retry used 12 model calls and 23k tokens, charged to the condition's compute.

retries.reflection: I failed because I never found the cloth to put in the drawer; I only examined countertops and drawers without searching for the cloth object. Instead, I should have systematically searched all visible areas like countertops and drawers for the cloth before attempting to place it. I need to look more carefully at each location to find the cloth item.

operations.example: search toilet 1, sinkbasin 1, countertop 1, garbagecan 1, drawers; take cloth 1 from toilet 1; open drawer 1; move cloth 1 to drawer 1.
operations.rule: When an object must be picked up and placed: search all visible areas first, take the object from its location, open the target container if closed, move the object there.
